The projects are Apache-2.0, so a business may build on them. This is general information, not financial or legal advice.

|-
! Route
! How it works
! Fit

| Services around the commons
| Hosting, migration, support, integration and training for teams moving off a vendor

| Early customers fund work they need
| Works once something runs; see project status

| GitHub Sponsors, Open Collective, direct support from companies that depend on the software
| Slow to build; best with an adopted project

| Rarely a fit for software given away under a permissive licence unless a services or hosting business sits on top

<span id="cautions"></span>
== Cautions ==

* A permissive licence means anyone, including a large vendor, may run and sell the same software. Compete on service, trust and fit, not on exclusivity.
* Do not imply affiliation with the vendors whose APIs we are compatible with.
* Tell customers plainly which project features are shipped and which are planned (see [[Outbound messaging]]).
* Keep the business separate from the collective’s accounts (see [[Basic business setup]]).
